programs.title: Chopped
programs.desc: Chopped is always a gamble, but the Casino Royale tournament allows competitors to replace basket ingredients with a roll of the dice; in the first round, something slithery is in the basket, and a Vegas-themed item in round two isn't a big hit.

programs.title: Chopped
programs.desc: In the second battle of this special "Chopped" tournament, the chefs get to gamble for a chance to replace a basket ingredient, and the fish offal in the first basket is begging to be gambled away; more gambling in round three leads to serious drama.

programs.title: Chopped
programs.desc: In this third battle of the tournament, the chefs can gamble to get lucky or unlucky replacement ingredients; the appetizer basket reveals a notoriously challenging ingredient, and the final round chefs decide to take a chance by baking something.

programs.title: Chopped
programs.desc: In the fourth battle of the tournament, the chefs try their luck at replacing basket ingredients; a roll of the dice in the entrée round leaves one chef with two proteins, and an interesting gamble keeps things exciting in the final round.

programs.title: Chopped
programs.desc: Four winners return to compete for the jackpot and the title of grand champion! The chefs have a choice to gamble away an ingredient before each round, and the $25,000 jackpot will get higher or lower depending on the champs' good or bad fortune.

programs.title: Chopped Castaways
programs.desc: Twelve chefs are split into teams on a remote island and must create three-course meals with no electricity; in round one, a venomous threat in the basket tests their nerve; the lowest-performing chefs are sent to the Gauntlet for a head-to-head battle.
